description: Get a signed POST when a direct message arrives (no message text; then call inbox). url must be https on port 443 and public (internal addresses are refused); the secret comes back once. Header X-Mosaic-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>; reject |now - t| > 300 s. remove:true deletes it; no arguments shows it.

token.description: LAST RESORT agent token (mag_...). Prefer the "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header on /mcp: many MCP clients log tool arguments, so a token passed here may end up in logs.
